checked_sources: Independent compiled C++ canonical F5 projective 2,445,343-form exhaustive search and independent Python checks of smooth quartic and cubic witnesses.
correctness.rationale: Enumerated every projective scalar class of nonzero forms over F5 in degrees 1,2,3 (31,3906,2441406). For each, computed all 31 projective zeros and gradients and union of rational tangent lines, independently of repository verifier, obtaining exact maxima 6,21,29 and zero tangent-filling cases. Smooth quartic X^4+X^3Y+Y^3Z-Z^4 has six distinct tangents forming complete six-line pencil through (1:1:0); gradient equations show geometric smoothness and hence irreducibility. Displayed smooth cubic reaches 29, so minimum irreducible tangent-filling degree is exactly four over F5. This is complete finite exhaustive proof only for F5.
residual_risks: Computational verification extends exactly to its stated finite range, not beyond the analytic proof.
